rules.rationale: Source: smiles_long lowered solubility (-11.46); logD opposes logS, so larger carbon scaffolds raise lipophilicity.
Source: smiles_short raised solubility (+6.89); small compact molecules expose little nonpolar surface.
Heteroatom role maps from H-bond donor evidence (weight 0.509); fewer polar atoms lowers desolvation cost.
Ring role carried the strongest source transfer weight (0.758); fused hydrophobic rings favor octanol partitioning.

skills.hypothesis: Transfers ESOL size, heteroatom, and ring effects with reversed sign, treating logD as anti-correlated with logS. Fails if lipophilicity here is size-saturated or driven by polar-group placement rather than bulk hydrophobic surface.

rules.rationale: High heteroatom density raises hydrogen bonding and aqueous stabilization, so desolvation cost suppresses measured lipophilicity.
Extended pi surface with only moderate polarity yields large nonpolar contact area; chemically meaningful interaction for octanol partitioning.
Moderate halogenation raises polarizability and hydrophobic surface; halogen_mid (743) is far better supported than halogen_high (98).
Counter-hypothesis reversing the low-confidence (0.224) length transfer: extreme-length molecules often carry polar solubilizing groups, saturating or inverting the size effect.

skills.hypothesis: Domain-knowledge counter-view: polarity penalty plus aromatic and halogen hydrophobic surface drives lipophilicity, and the uncertain length relation reverses at extreme lengths. Fails if bulk molecular size dominates partitioning in this pool.

state.lesson: Across two independent eight-seed development blocks the sign-reversed ESOL transfer skill led on mean AUC (89.59 vs 89.26 this generation; 89.04 vs 85.73 previously) and on mean final best, and it never trailed. The second-generation counterview narrowed the gap to roughly 0.3 AUC points, but the difference sits inside seed noise, so the honest read is that the source-grounded bulk and ring rules are at least as good and cheaper to justify. Eight seeds per generation cannot establish mechanism; they only justify keeping the simpler, source-grounded hypothesis in front.
state.revision_summary: Kept the proven source-transfer skill nearly frozen: raised the ring_token_high weight from 0.35 to 0.40, since the source ring role carried the highest transfer weight (0.758) and both generation blocks favored this skill, while leaving ridge, prior_scale, semantic mass, and the anchor blend untouched to avoid overfitting sixteen total development seeds. Rebuilt the counter-hypothesis skill around well-supported bins: dropped the sparse halogen_high anchor in favor of halogen_mid, kept the aromatic_high x hetero_mid interaction, and reformulated the very-long-length rule as an explicit size-saturation reversal of the 0.224-confidence length transfer. All conditions objects are direct field-to-value mappings drawn verbatim from the public catalog. Deployed the source-evidence-grounded transfer skill.
